components.css: .ds-spread { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; background: var(--feature, #f7dfaf); color: var(--ink, #192d32); border-radius: 10px; padding: 18px 24px; } .ds-spread::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: -26px; bottom: -125px; width: 300px; height: 280px; border-radius: 50%; z-index: -1; background: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse at center, transparent 0 12px, currentColor 13px 14px, transparent 15px 22px); color: var(--rust, #8a3d22); opacity: 0.28; } .ds-spread > * { max-width: 76%; } .ds-spread-kind { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 500 13px/19px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-2, #46595b); } .ds-spread h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 500 29px/35px Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-spread button { font: 500 14px/20px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary, #192d32); color: var(--on-primary, #f7f6ef); border: 1px solid var(--primary, #192d32); cursor: pointer; } .ds-spread button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #164d84); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The Dashboard is a desk laid out for one working day.
Warm paper sits under blue-black ink, the search field is the first thing within reach, what is timely now gets one sheet of its own, and recurring work reads like a ruled index.
The owner should recognise a request from its left edge and decide from its subject whether to read further.

The mood is calm, exact and literate.
Calm, because nothing pulses, shimmers, slides or re-sorts on its own, and an empty or healthy state is one quiet line rather than a celebration.
Exact, because every time is in tabular figures, every count is precise or written as a lower bound, and every state is said in words beside its glyph.
Literate, because Georgia gives page and section titles an editorial cadence while Inter keeps everything the owner acts on plain.

Density is that of a well-set index: generous 14 px row padding, 1 px rules between rows, and one 1072 px reading column on every screen.
Dark mode is the same desk at night: the paper becomes deep green slate, the ink becomes pale cream, and the morning spread becomes amber-brown.
The theme follows the system and never offers its own toggle.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper canvas, a slightly brighter sheet for cards and fields, and blue-black ink.
Georgia for page, section and detail titles; Inter for everything else; system mono for times, keys, paths and kind captions.
Flat ruled rows on the canvas, square at their ends, separated by 1 px rules and grouped under a 2 px ink rule.
Colour appears only in a kind's stamp and word, from seven role hues, and never alone.
The brass Attention dot means one thing: a decision waits.
Shadow only on what floats above the page.

rules.name: The Brass Means Decide Rule
rules.body: The Attention dot follows the Decision count and nothing else. It never means new, unread, changed or offline, and brass is never used as a general accent.

rules.name: The Colour Lives in the Stamp Rule
rules.body: A row's hue appears only in its kind stamp and kind word. Rows keep flat 1 px rules: no tinted group headers, no coloured side bars, no tinted row backgrounds.

rules.name: The Never Alone Rule
rules.body: A hue always comes with a glyph and a word, so every kind stays distinguishable in grayscale and under colour-vision simulation.

rules.name: The Healthy Is Quiet Rule
rules.body: A working state is a word in Ink Meta and nothing more. Tags are for exceptions only, and there is no green "OK" tag.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Georgia names places: the page, its sections, the thing being read. Inter carries everything the owner reads in a row or acts on. Never set a button, row subject or field in Georgia.

rules.name: The Tabular Times Rule
rules.body: Every `time` and every count uses tabular figures, so times line up down a list and a count never jitters as it changes.

rules.name: The Roman Quotes Rule
rules.body: The bundled face has no italic, so quotes and emphasis stay roman; a quote is marked by its rule or its label, never by slanting.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Nothing on any screen leaves the 1072 px column or its gutters, and no screen scrolls sideways.

rules.name: The Nothing Jumps Rule
rules.body: A place that will fill keeps its height while empty: Show new items holds its row, For you now keeps a quiet line, and an older query's results stay dimmed for their height until the new answer comes.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow is never decoration. If a layer does not float above the page and leave again, it has no shadow.

dos: **Do** take every colour from `apps/web/src/styles/tokens.css` and let `contrast.test.ts` prove it: 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for edges in both themes.
**Do** use `hueClass(hue)` and `--c` / `--c-soft` for a kind's colour, and pair every hue with its glyph and word.
**Do** set page, section and detail titles in Georgia, and every row subject, control and field in Inter.
**Do** put lists on the canvas as square ruled rows under a 2 px ink rule, and put detail on a Fresh Sheet with a 1 px Rule and 10 px corners.
**Do** show focus as the 3 px Focus Blue outline and selection as an ink fill or inset ink bar, so the two can never be confused.
**Do** keep the place of anything that will fill, so arrivals never move the list under the pointer.
**Do** give every control a 44 x 44 px target on a phone or with a coarse pointer, and keep every screen working at 320 px and 200% zoom.
**Do** stop every transition and animation under reduced motion; the only motion at all is a 0.15 s chevron turn and the progress bar's width.
donts: **Don't** use the brass dot or brass colour for anything but a waiting decision: not new, unread, changed, offline or decoration.
**Don't** tint rows, group headers or side bars with a hue, or add a coloured bar to a row.
**Don't** add a green tag for a healthy state; say the state quietly in words.
**Don't** use the Morning Amber spread for anything but a lead morning briefing.
**Don't** add a shadow to anything that does not float above the page.
**Don't** add shimmer, pulse, auto-advancing cards, sliding transitions or animated re-sorting.
**Don't** load anything from the internet, including a typeface; Georgia and the mono face are the system's, Inter is bundled.
**Don't** set text in italic, or use the logo's copper and brass for text.
**Don't** add a chat box, a conversation surface or a theme toggle.
